question: Why did the Order API become slow on September 16? Check whether the deployment was related and whether we have seen this before.

documents.title: Order API latency spike
documents.content: P95 latency increased significantly. The incident began shortly after the latest deployment.

documents.title: Orders deployment
documents.content: Version v2.8.1 was deployed to production at 18:10 UTC.

documents.title: Previous latency incident
documents.content: A previous latency incident was caused by database connection saturation during a schema migration.
